decisions.purpose: Provider calls and research result validation
decisions.quality: Useful bounded logic; adaptation and new verification required
decisions.reason: Port deadline/abort, endpoint allowlist, safe error codes and strict probability checks. Replace roles, prompts and result envelopes; require a bounded stream reader. Do not port research() wholesale.
decisions.risks: readJson fallback response.text reads unbounded before checking size. TypeClient forces missing=[] and omits provider request identity. Local correlation must not masquerade as remote request ID. Remote availability not verified

decisions.purpose: Legacy CEO result schema
decisions.quality: Existing implementation unsuitable for target
decisions.reason: No strategy lifecycle, causal chain or quant/critic proposal references. New decision contracts must include confidence, evidence_quality, missing_evidence, uncertainty, regime, network, strategy version and the full causal evidence chain.
decisions.risks: Legacy approval must not authorize execution

decisions.purpose: Codex process orchestration and decision
decisions.quality: Useful bounded logic; adaptation and new verification required
decisions.reason: Retain isolated tool-disabled subprocess and response validation; rewrite mandate and proposal contract. The new commander requires persistent world state, objectives, uncertainty, task planning, evidence synthesis, risk awareness, an auditable NO_ACTION decision and failure recovery; a subprocess transport alone is not a decision brain.
decisions.risks: Prompt biases toward approval; current tool/CLI compatibility not verified

decisions.purpose: Direct BUY/HOLD/SELL model decisions
decisions.quality: Excluded from target, not a general quality assertion
decisions.reason: Direct trade brain violates required proposal -> lifecycle -> strategy -> risk path.
decisions.risks: Live account mandate and duplicated subprocess implementation

decisions.purpose: Optional read-only market/trending API
decisions.quality: Useful bounded logic; adaptation and new verification required
decisions.reason: Allowlisted routes, response bounds, provenance hash and sanitized errors are useful.
decisions.risks: Requires external credential; trending is not verified social sentiment

decisions.purpose: Fixed-point paper balances and receipts
decisions.quality: Useful bounded logic; adaptation and new verification required
decisions.reason: Retain integer accounting, prorated cost basis and idempotency; replace network coupling and validate complete V2 trade lineage.
decisions.risks: Restore/input invariant completeness needs new tests; six-decimal USD model

decisions.purpose: Parallel read-only trading supervisor
decisions.quality: Excluded from target, not a general quality assertion
decisions.reason: server.mjs imports RobinhoodAutopilot, not this class. This old supervisor has no production caller found; do not transfer the module. Event dedupe will be implemented in the authoritative runtime.
decisions.risks: Separate state and timer create second source of truth. Fingerprint is consumed even on failed brain call, preventing retry of unchanged evidence

decisions.purpose: Real transaction/approval preparation
decisions.quality: Excluded from target, not a general quality assertion
decisions.reason: Swap/approve/multicall transaction construction is excluded from paper-only target.
decisions.risks: Wallet transaction payloads must not reach dashboard

decisions.purpose: Risk, execution, exits, ledger, performance
decisions.quality: Existing implementation unsuitable for target
decisions.reason: Useful risk/atomic rollback/quote checks must be separated; old class mixes at least five responsibilities and fixed exits. Keep strategy evaluation, independent risk approval, intent creation and paper fills separate; all actions require approved immutable evidence and network identity.
decisions.risks: Partial exit trusts reason string; lifecycle and complete lineage absent

decisions.purpose: Limits and holder/verifier gates
decisions.quality: Useful bounded logic; adaptation and new verification required
decisions.reason: Port conservative integer holder bounds and probability validation; remove unproven legacy boolean shortcut and hardcoded strategy. Implement the retained invariants behind an independent Risk Engine with unconditional veto, exposure/sizing/liquidity/concentration/drawdown/cooldown limits. Regime and uncertainty constrain risk.
decisions.risks: Counterexample proves holder PASS without coverage evidence

decisions.purpose: Compact source/quote evidence
decisions.quality: Useful bounded logic; adaptation and new verification required
decisions.reason: Port only selected field allowlists and integer round-trip arithmetic after strict input validation. Rewrite incomplete-pair branch to an explicit unavailable result. Always bind typed immutable evidence references.
decisions.risks: quoteEvidence returns arbitrary input unchanged when either quote is missing, bypassing allowlist. optionalSourceStatus defaults absent reads to READ. coverageMeaning trusts legacy boolean. Cannot treat modeled quote as observed fill

decisions.purpose: Autonomous live funding/signing/trades
decisions.quality: Excluded from target, not a general quality assertion
decisions.reason: Entire live autopilot and custodial path are outside scope.
decisions.risks: Signs/broadcasts and holds bot wallet secret

decisions.purpose: Pool/swap decoding and wallet ranking
decisions.quality: Existing implementation unsuitable for target
decisions.reason: Retain authenticated-log discovery concept; remove live-trade import, validate chain/log provenance, bound caches, correct incomplete cost basis.
decisions.risks: Counterexample proves unobserved-basis sells become fabricated profit

decisions.purpose: Private-key vault and transaction signing
decisions.quality: Excluded from target, not a general quality assertion
decisions.reason: New wallet layer must never generate, store, sign with or return private keys.
decisions.risks: Direct custody and raw signed transaction capability

decisions.purpose: Legacy global orchestration/state/feedback
decisions.quality: Existing implementation unsuitable for target
decisions.reason: Global object mixes scheduling, risk, quote sizing, UI messages, wallet gating and all old AI roles. Rewrite event-driven autonomous observation/decision/learning orchestration, START/STOP, durable tasks, module isolation and network-switch cancellation; never auto-BUY on candidate arrival.
decisions.risks: No quant walk-forward, five-class forensic or versioned champion lifecycle

decisions.purpose: HTTP/SSE/config/wallet/live endpoints
decisions.quality: Existing implementation unsuitable for target
decisions.reason: Port bounded local API ideas; omit all live endpoints, tunnels and legacy static routes.
decisions.risks: Default constructs live autopilot; legacy UI and private config coupling

decisions.purpose: Pump logs/RPC/holders/quotes/wallet tracking
decisions.quality: Useful bounded logic; adaptation and new verification required
decisions.reason: PORT only decodePumpLogs authenticated-frame algorithm and bounded read-only rpc/jsonResponse ideas, with current SDK validation required before deployment. REWRITE source lifecycle/enrichment/quotes independently. Same-slot holder proof is a candidate idea, not accepted implementation. No wholesale SolanaSource or old quote/cost math transfer. The hunter proactively ranks candidates for the active network; switching away cancels or quarantines SOL work and rejects stale cross-network results.
decisions.risks: Historical auxiliary classifier suggested decoder PORT; this has no acceptance authority. SDK/deployed-layout proof for quotes remains CHUA_XAC_MINH and is excluded from any authorized port. walletLeaders returns BigInt comparator and treats cash flow as profit; drop old ranking. All provider runtime availability remains unverified

decisions.purpose: GeckoTerminal Robinhood discovery
decisions.quality: Useful bounded logic; adaptation and new verification required
decisions.reason: Useful public discovery and raw-response hash; normalize through typed candidates. Discovery must use the selected network universe and verified provider capabilities; no hidden fallback to another chain.
decisions.risks: Hardcoded chain, mutable RPC allowlist, response bounds and identity checks incomplete

decisions.purpose: Receipt-derived performance metrics
decisions.quality: Existing implementation unsuitable for target
decisions.reason: Position win rate must aggregate all partial exits through final close; count fills separately.
decisions.risks: Counterexample: one net winning position is reported as two closes and 50% win rate

decisions.purpose: SQLite state/events/evidence transactions
decisions.quality: Useful bounded logic; adaptation and new verification required
decisions.reason: Retain transaction atomicity and parameterized statements; add schema validation, unique event IDs, replay and lineage. Persist candidates, positions, strategies/champion/challengers, regime, AI tasks, failures, risk state, decision journal, performance attribution and unresolved anomalies.
decisions.risks: saveMany assumes nonempty events; no V2 versioned contract or event dedupe

decisions.purpose: Direct live trading decision schema
decisions.quality: Excluded from target, not a general quality assertion
decisions.reason: DROP this exact old artifact, not the general idea of JSON validation. New StrategyDecision/ExecutionIntent must be distinct typed contracts. Its only source caller is the excluded codex-trader.mjs.
decisions.risks: Schema itself does not sign; its caller directly chooses BUY/SELL without required strategy version, signal, evidence or lifecycle identity

decisions.purpose: Credential configuration and DPAPI
decisions.quality: Existing implementation unsuitable for target
decisions.reason: Keep provider credentials separate from wallet and public state; do not migrate private files or bot-key vault.
decisions.risks: Windows-only subprocess and mixed config concerns

decisions.purpose: Public session and read-only balances
decisions.quality: Useful bounded logic; adaptation and new verification required
decisions.reason: Retain chain validation, public-only lease and disconnect invalidation; independent adapters, no liveEnabled path. Changing active network must drive the matching hunter/provider subscriptions. Existing positions/history retain original network identity; unsupported Robinhood/provider capability remains CHUA_XAC_MINH.
decisions.risks: Imports registry from old frontend; five networks vs required four; no ownership proof
